title: B1.11 AgeTracer pond precipitation/irrigation boundary amount and top flux

baseline.source_equation: AgeTracer task-2 surface AgeSurf, qtop<-1e-6 branch, Ageflux top, isqtop and downward cumulative boundary term

scope.inputs: Already-materialized nird, cirr, nraidt, Agepre, dtsolu, Pondm1, qtop, pond, ArMpSs, Agepondm1 and runots
scope.equations: Agesurf=(nird*Ageirr+nraidt*Agepre)*dtsolu+Pondm1*Agepondm1; if qtop<-1e-6: Agepond=Agesurf/(pond-qtop*dtsolu), Agefluxt=qtop*(1-ArMpSs)*Agepond*dtsolu, Agesurf+=Agefluxt, isqtop=qtop*(1-ArMpSs)*Agepond, icAgetopdwn increment=qtop*(1-ArMpSs)*0.5*(Agepond+Agepondm1)*dtsolu; else Agepond=Agefluxt=isqtop=0. Surface cumulative increment=0.5*(Agepond+Agepondm1)*runots.
scope.state_owner: None; inputs explicit and outputs numeric candidates only

qualification: Compare deterministic source-order vectors to direct B1.11 expressions at O0/O2
Exercise qtop threshold below/equal/above, ArMpSs, irrigation/precipitation contributions and positive pond denominator
Reject nonfinite inputs and nonpositive denominator on the active branch
No surface-water or age pond state owner, time loop or production claim
decision_rule: Preserve the qtop<-1e-6 branch and explicit formula operation order; do not silently include/infer state mutation or repair behavior outside the source expression.
